title: Glass and glass-ceramics - Knoop hardness test
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (IS 14260) covers Glass and glass-ceramics - Knoop hardness test. This Indian Standard which is identical with ISO 9385:1990 Glass and glass-ceramacis- Knoop hardness test, issued by the International Organization for Standardization (ISO), was adopted by the Council. The Knoop hardness number characterises the behaviour of glass and glass-ceramacis concerning a permanent change of the surface after indentation with a solid material. This is one of a series of standards relating to the optical glass and glass ceramic testing. The text of ISO standard has been approved as suitable for publication as Indian Standard without deviations. Certain conventions are however not identical to those use in Indian Standards. Attention is particularly drawn to the following: a) Comma (,) has been used as a decimal marker while in Indian Standards the current practice is to use a full stop (.) as the decimal marker. b) Wherever the words 'International Standard' appear referring to this standard, they should be read as 'Indian Standard'. ISO 9385 : 1990 Indian Stan

mechanical_properties: hardness number, apply the test force of 0,980 7 N
marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
